task_failure_diagnosis.observed: Official pytest verifier collected one test; no alert appeared in the browser within five seconds; reward 0

task_failure_diagnosis.task_instruction_caveat: The upstream instruction says the file can be run to verify; this is ambiguous because it does not self-execute its test
task_failure_diagnosis.underlying_browser_cause: Not established beyond absence of the expected alert
task_failure_diagnosis.transport: Commands and terminal observations are retained in the trajectory; no task exception
task_failure_diagnosis.numerical_attribution: Baseline task failure does not establish a scaled-input regression

feature_audit.thinking: Adapter fixes enable_thinking=false; chat parser rejects true. Possible quality factor requiring a separate matched comparison, not a proven cause
feature_audit.tools: Terminus JSON command protocol worked in the observed task. ATIF tool_calls are its normalized representation and do not prove native API tool-call coverage
feature_audit.generation: Omitted temperature defaults to greedy 0; common to all arms. Independent effect on quality has not been tested
feature_audit.ceilings: Peak failed-task prompt 4806 and output 1771 are below configured 262144/4096. ATIF lacks finish_reason; no full wire-level truncation audit
feature_audit.cache_batch_mtp: Disabled in this profile; primarily performance features. Their absence is not an observed cause of this task failure
feature_audit.generalization: Results apply to the frozen text-only, thinking-off composition, not full model capability or latest core branch

next_comparison: Keep task/scoring/serving profile frozen across Q2 arithmetic arms. Qualify thinking and any core/template changes in a separate cohort; do not feed the failure diagnosis to the evaluated agents.
